evidence.quote: this policy applies regardless of whether the code was written by hand, with AI assistance, or generated entirely by an AI tool.
You must have personally reviewed and understood all changes before submitting.
PR descriptions, issue comments, and review responses must be your own words.
Do not paste AI-generated text as comments or review responses.
Using AI to improve the language of your writing (grammar, phrasing, spelling, etc.) is acceptable.
